rationale: Extend the existing authoritative-publication responsibility with a generic, insurer- and topic-neutral materializer that composes already-governed certification, explicit semantic components, publication decision, authoritative gate, and existing published-evidence contracts. It adds no new publication authority, fact system, product adapter, topic inference, or recommendation capability.
supersession_impact: No capability or historical publication path is superseded. Existing bounded Star publication builders remain historical implementations; the new generic materializer provides the reusable onboarding path without changing their behavior.
authority_impact: Authority remains entirely in the existing certification, publication-decision, and authoritative-publication contracts. The materializer cannot publish non-PASS certification, uncertified semantic components, missing evidence references, unresolved publication boundaries, or gate-prohibited limitations; it only composes and validates explicit governed inputs.
